t: Forge Steel pin punch set is an essential manual tool kit for efficiently removing stubborn pins and rivets from various components. The hardened steel shaft construction ensures long-lasting durability and reliable performance for demanding workshop tasks. An ergonomic soft-grip handle provides enhanced user comfort and improved control during prolonged use, reducing hand fatigue. The versatile 8-piece set includes common sizes from 2.4mm to 10mm, making it ideal for professional mechanics, engineers, and serious DIYers tackling automotive repairs, machinery maintenance, or intricate assembly and disassembly projects.
